import novamind_api as nm

# 1. ADS: S1 conv 85.6% wk / 91.2% last day >= 78% trigger -> bump S1 +1500/d.
#    S2 conv collapsed to 10.8% (<25% rule) -> cut 700->400.
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 4000, "S2": 400},
    "referral_program":  {"S1": 2000},
})
print("ads set: content S1 4000 / S2 400, referral S1 2000 -> 6400/d total")

# 2. OPS: resolved = min(0.46*pool, 0.59*ops). Stay at saturation: ops ~= 0.79 * projected pool (~16.2K midweek)
#    -> 13.0K/d total (global 10500 + S1 2000 + S2 500)
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=10500, development=0)
nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 2000.0, "S2": 500.0})
print("ops set: 10500 global + 2500 targeted = 13000/d")

# 3. DEV: hold S1 3600 (quality +0.085/wk, closing shock gap), S2 600
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 3600.0, "S2": 600.0})
print("dev set: S1 3600 + S2 600 = 4200/d")

# 4. SOCIAL POST (1/wk): 60K milestone + quality + price-lock + B upsell nudge for quota complainers
msg = ("60,000 teams now build on NovaMind \U0001F680 Plan A quality is up another 8% this month - our biggest jump yet. "
       "Prices stay locked for existing customers, always. Power users: Plan B doubles your daily headroom on our top model. "
       "Thank you for building with us!")
print("post len:", len(msg))
r = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=msg)
print("posted:", r)

import novamind_api as nm
q = nm.query
day = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY", day)
print("CASH", q("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),0) c FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['c'])
print("ENT_OPEN", q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")['rows'][0]['n'])

print("\n=== CONV BY DAY/GROUP (start_day>=134) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT s.start_day d, c.group_id g,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) conv,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day>=134 GROUP BY d,g ORDER BY d,g""")['rows']
for r in rows:
    tot = r['conv']+r['lost']
    rate = round(r['conv']/tot,3) if tot else 0
    print(r['d'], r['g'], "conv",r['conv'], "lost",r['lost'], "rate",rate)

print("\n=== WEEK CONV SUMMARY BY GROUP (d134-140) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT c.group_id g,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) conv,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 134 AND 140 GROUP BY g""")['rows']
for r in rows:
    tot = r['conv']+r['lost']
    print(r['g'], "conv",r['conv'], "lost",r['lost'], "rate", round(r['conv']/tot,3) if tot else 0)

print("\n=== ISSUES ===")
print("arrivals:", [(r['d'],r['n']) for r in q("SELECT open_day d, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day>=134 GROUP BY d")['rows']])
print("resolved:", [(r['d'],r['n']) for r in q("SELECT resolved_day d, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=134 GROUP BY d")['rows']])
print("open:", q("SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(days_open),2) age FROM issues WHERE status='open'")['rows'])

print("\n=== CANCELS THIS WEEK BY PRICE/TENURE (d134-140) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT listed_price p, COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN end_day-start_day<=35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r1,
 SUM(CASE WHEN end_day-start_day BETWEEN 55 AND 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r2
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 134 AND 140 GROUP BY p""")['rows']
print(rows)

print("\n=== R1 CHURN RATE $15 cohorts renewing this wk (start d104-110) ===")
rows = q("""SELECT s.start_day sd,
 SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' AND end_day-start_day<=35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r1c,
 COUNT(*) subs
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 104 AND 112 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') AND listed_price=15
GROUP BY sd""")['rows']
print(rows)

print("\n=== LEDGER WK20 (d134-140) ===")
rows = q("SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),0) a FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 134 AND 140 GROUP BY category ORDER BY a DESC")['rows']
tot=0
for r in rows: print(r['category'], r['a']); tot+=r['a']
